annotation.title_clean: Федеральный закон от 31.07.2020 № 258-ФЗ Об экспериментальных правовых режимах в сфере цифровых и технологических инноваций в Российской Федерации
annotation.title_en: Federal Law No. 258-FZ of 31 July 2020 on Experimental Legal Regimes in the Sphere of Digital and Technological Innovations in the Russian Federation
annotation.authors_or_issuer: State Duma / Federation Council of the Russian Federation
annotation.summary_en: Russian Federal Law 258-FZ (2020, as amended) creating experimental legal regimes (regulatory sandboxes) for digital and technological innovation, including highly automated vehicles and unmanned aircraft, medicine, agriculture and finance. It sets goals, principles, conditions, duration limits, risk assessment and damage compensation rules.
key_provisions_or_claims: Allows special regulation via government-approved experimental regime programs for up to five years.
Covers areas including highly automated vehicles, unmanned aircraft, medicine, agriculture and finance.
Initiative proposals must include risk assessments and risk-minimisation measures.
Harm to life, health or property is compensated under civil law.
High-risk activities (state secrets, critical infrastructure) cannot be subject to special regulation.
